evidence: 2026-09-29: real signup through the Agent Vault proxy using this recipe (MCP session, vault-minted password); all five selectors matched. After Create account the page went to the Economist home page with no log-in link and no code or challenge; a fresh sign-in with the same credentials was accepted, and The Economist's welcome mail ("Your curiosity has a new home") arrived at the signup address about 13 minutes later.
gotchas: Field ids are generated (input-10); the name attributes are stable, which is what these selectors use.
The password must be at least 8 characters.
The form also requires a job title and an industry; they are the account owner's to supply.
A free account; reading beyond the free allowance is a paid subscription, which is not part of this signup.
Job title and industry are autocomplete fields: typing opens a list, and an option has to be picked from it (for example Analyst; an industry beginning Media).
The offers checkbox is unticked by default.
The welcome mail can take over ten minutes to arrive; the account is usable at once.
